biggest_catch: Your $25 is paid only when your friend opens both a Membership Savings Account and a Cash-Back Checking Account with a debit card — and you're capped at 20 referrals ($500) per calendar year.
catches: $25 is deposited to your Membership Savings Account when your friend opens their Membership Savings Account and Cash-Back Checking Account with a debit card.
Existing members are limited to twenty (20) referrals per calendar year — effectively a $500/year cap.
Your friend must include your ReferCode in the Promo Code/Refer A Friend section when opening online, or mention it at a branch.
A+FCU employees, volunteers, and their families are excluded; person must have US SSN/ITIN and be 13 or older; program subject to change without notice; cannot be combined with any other offer.
Separate business referral track: $100 per referred business (limit 5 per calendar year) — not the personal $25 program verified here.
